artifact.selection_uses: New calibration seeds only; no fresh-development or previous-batch output used

point_estimator_selection.criterion: Mean of five leave-one-seed-out target-weighted MAEs; abs tie <=1e-9 selects median

artifact.weighted_quantile_definition: Smallest observed length where cumulative target-mixture mass reaches p, exact rational weights
artifact.residual_quantile_definition: Empirical type7 positive-residual quantiles; OOF is the primary static-bound diagnostic, in-sample sensitivity separately reported
artifact.out_of_sample_update: Not implemented or simulated here; real M must only consume feedback already completed at its decision time
artifact.coverage_scope: Descriptive only, no conformal or unconditional tail/latency/capacity guarantee
artifact.response_quality_scope: Executed length, EOS and no context truncation do not establish correct, useful or instruction-complete answers; independent output-budget sentinels are analyzed separately
artifact.mixture_caveat: 200/230 interactive mass exceeds .85, all interactive executed lengths <=64; target-weighted actual q85 is therefore <=64 and can make predicted classes coincide with business labels

collection_status.scope: Serial length/prediction validation only. No 100-second load comparison, no hard ledger or M/B3 scheduling, no final data. Do not pool with the earlier 2010 load measurements.

scope: Expanded calibration/model selection and untouched-development verification of executed output length only; no M/B3 decisions or performance comparison.
limits: Five LOSO folds share training data; no claim that they are five independent scheduler experiments.
A balanced calibration/verification sample is reweighted to one predeclared main mixture, not all workloads.
Classifications and false-short/long labels use executed capped lengths, not uncapped natural output.
Static bound equality/difference is not actual admission equality/difference or algorithm value.
EOS and absence of context truncation do not establish answer quality; separate sentinels do not enter this fit.
Primary target-weighted threshold and point estimator are fixed using calibration alone; development results never select alternatives.
